lines.zh: 我四条腿走着，可步子不对。
lines.en: I walk on four legs, but the gait is wrong.
I make a lap along the fence.

lines.zh: 毛掉了一块，露出下面的东西。
lines.en: Patches of wool are gone, showing what's beneath.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，像有人在拽。
lines.en: I stop and start as if something pulls me.
Head low, I brush through the grass.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边咩了一声。
lines.en: I bleat once as I walk.
That sound isn't a sheep's anymore.
I go around the flock; they avoid me.
I make my way to the water trough.
My tail is stiff and still.

lines.zh: 我回头看了看自己的侧腹。
lines.en: I look back at my own flank.
I scrape along the wall one step at a time.
The grass I step on blackens a little.
My four hooves each walk their own way.
I head for the sheep pen I know.
The ground feels sticky underfoot.
I stand while my wool shivers.
I lower my head to graze and can't chew.
The skin under my wool is pulsing.
I snort out a breath.
I hear the flock bleating far off.

lines.zh: 我转头看它们，它们退开了。
lines.en: I look their way and they back off.
Something on me is swelling.
My eyelids fold the wrong way.
Things crawl in my wool.
I want to lie down and can't.
The shade is a little cooler than out there.
I smell what's coming off me.
It isn't the smell of a sheep.
I shake my head and can't shake it off.
I bleat again.
It's lower than before.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的头。
lines.en: Your shadow falls over my head.
I lift my head; my neck is stiff.
The grass smell gets stronger as you come closer.

lines.zh: 你退的每一步我都数着。
lines.en: I count every step you take backward.
You're afraid of me — I understand.

lines.zh: 我的毛下露出黑色的东西。
lines.en: Black stuff shows beneath my wool.
I bleat, and it sounds awful.
I have no intention of chasing you.
I go around you and move on.
I look at you because you didn't run.

lines.zh: 我还记得怎么被人摸头。
lines.en: I still remember being patted on the head.
I lower my head, and you don't reach out.
I bleat and pull away.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我毛厚的背上。
lines.en: That landed on my matted wool.
A patch of wool came off.
My legs give and I kneel.
Something in me is twitching.
I turn to look at the wound.
I stop bleating — I can't.

lines.zh: 我撑起前腿，又滑了一下。
lines.en: I push up on my front legs, then slide back down.
I still want to keep walking.
I lift my head and stare at your hands.
This is fresh grass.
I sniff it and want it badly.
I chew and can't swallow.
My mouth doesn't taste things the same.
I eat a little anyway.
I remember this taste from before.
I eat slowly, one bite after another.

lines.zh: 有些东西从嘴角流出来。
lines.en: Something runs from the corner of my mouth.
The grass you set down — I ate it.

lines.zh: 你的手上有草，我凑近了。
lines.en: Your hand smells of grass, so I come closer.
I can't speak; I can only bleat.
Set down a little more.
I stand by the grass and don't move.
I lower my head for another bite.

lines.zh: 吃下去，肚子里有东西在动。
lines.en: It goes down, and something in my belly moves.
I can finish this much.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我歪着走了两步。
lines.en: You bump me and I stagger two steps.
My wool catches on your clothes.
That knock hurt me.
I back against the fence.
I'm shoved up against the post.
We scrape past each other.
Your hit turns me sideways.
I steady myself and you step back.
Sorry — I can't control it well.
I shift aside.
There are other sheep in the pen.

lines.zh: 羊圈空了一半，它们走了。
lines.en: Half the pen is empty; they've gone.

lines.zh: 我朝最近的那只靠过去。
lines.en: I lean toward the nearest one.
They all back away together.
I stand by the fence.

lines.zh: 我记得以前是挤在一起睡的。
lines.en: I remember sleeping huddled together.
I bleat and no one answers.
There's sheep smell on the wind.
I follow the smell.
They ran off.
I bite the roots and can't tear them loose.
It has no taste in my mouth.
I bite and spit it out.
I nudge it aside with my nose.
A piece of cloth — I pick it up.
I push it into my cheek and hide it.
I hold it under my hoof.
I can't swallow it.
I hold it and stand a long while.
Then I set it down.
There's movement by the fence.
I hear it first, then turn my head.
My legs move first.
I don't want to go over at all.
And yet my body is walking.

lines.zh: 我低头，把那对角顶向前。
lines.en: I lower my horns to the front.
I bleat, and it's vicious.

lines.zh: 我知道那是谁，可脚在走。
lines.en: I know whose voice that is, but my feet keep going.

lines.zh: 蹄子不听我的，一直向前。
lines.en: My hooves ignore me and keep going.
I can't stop at all.
I keep walking at it.
I drift toward it as I walk.
I'm not fast, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 它踢了我一下，我没感觉。
lines.en: It kicked me and I barely felt it.
Something on me is quivering.
I bleat low again.
It backs to the fence, and I follow.
I've pressed it against the fence.
It's trying to climb over.
I lower my head further.
I drive my forehead into you.
It's crushed against the fence.
I raise a hoof and stamp down.
That one landed heavily.
That one lands on its ribs.
That sound made me stop for a moment.
Then I moved again.
I bit into its clothes.
My mouth tastes of cloth and blood.
I slowly let go.

lines.zh: 我站在羊圈里，脚下是草。
lines.en: I stand in the pen with grass underfoot.
The other sheep are all in the corner.
They look at me and won't come closer.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看自己的腿。
lines.en: I look down at my own legs.
Under the wool, there's no wool.
I try to bleat.
The sound frightens even me.

lines.zh: 我站在草里，不知该去哪。
lines.en: I stand in the grass, not knowing where to go.
I still want to eat grass.
I walk to the grass and take a bite.

lines.zh: 毛烧起来了，下面的东西在扭。
lines.en: My wool catches, and what's beneath twists.
I broke a leg when I landed.

lines.zh: 我的毛吸饱了水，往下沉。
lines.en: My wool soaks full and drags me down.
The blast sends me rolling.
The arrow shaft quivers in me.

lines.zh: 身体里的东西被惊到了。
lines.en: Whatever's inside me has been startled.

lines.zh: 我什么都咽不下去，站不稳。
lines.en: I can't swallow anything; I can't stand steady.
Lightning strikes and my wool stands up.
I fall, hooves pawing at nothing.
